getQuoteData((address,address,bytes32)[].details: We use the unit of bitmaps (i.e. tickSpacings * 256) because that's a rough approximation of how the gas cost of this function scales

params.minBitmapsSearched: indicates the minimum number of initialized tick bitmaps the current tick should be searched for tick data

ownedPositions(address,address).details: Results share one block; order is unspecified. Large portfolios remain subject to      the RPC provider's eth_call gas and response limits. No data is silently truncated.
